name: spn-apps-ts
description: SaaS Plane apps domain, TypeScript instance: the five APPS verb skills — new, implement, review, run, verify — the golden-path step files, and the TS standards restated. Planning is not here: the verb is DEVEX_PLAN and lives once in spn-core, which loads refs/plan.md from this plugin for the APPS · TS layer. The book's SPSkillType is closed and carries no APPS_PLAN. A hook denies a write that breaks the enablement grammar — an enablement code not prefixed by its own module, a code whose second segment is not MANAGE, a multi-value definition named after its area, and a hardcoded set of organization types in a service (RD.SAAS.033). Three more hooks guard what proves a change: an unanchored host pattern in a navigation assertion is denied (the pattern matches inside a provider's redirect_uri, so the check could not fail), a route added with no case naming it warns, and a spec that mutates shared state with no interrupt-safe restore warns. Another hook denies a read verb in a contract service interface that returns an XList under a plural name — a get… method returning Promise<…List> is named get…List or get…ListBy…; a keyed map, a write verb and search… are left alone.
